instruction.text: Match the main clauses and subordinate clauses to make complex sentences.

atoms.b: even though he tried to get to the park on time.
atoms.sound: Tom was still late even though he tried to get to the park on time.
Lacy went to the cinema when it was raining.

atoms.b: she is still going to work.
atoms.sound: Although Martha is feeling unwell, she is still going to work.

atoms.a: Once Matt had finished his homework, ...
atoms.sound: Once Matt had finished his homework, he went for a run.

instruction.text: Match the main clauses and subordinate clauses to make complex sentences.

atoms.b: he went to pick up his daughter from her dance lesson.
atoms.sound: Once Ron had finished work, he went to pick up his daughter from her dance lesson.

atoms.a: Although Jack has never made a cake, ...
atoms.b: he is going to try to make one for the party.
atoms.sound: Although Jack has never made a cake, he is going to try to make one for the party.

atoms.a: Dave did not go to the party ...
atoms.sound: Dave did not go to the party because he was unwell.
She ate a banana because she was hungry.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: ssml: Celia can speak English fluently,<break time='500ms'/> she cannot understand German.
atoms.b: Celia can speak English fluently, ((++whereas since)) she cannot understand German.

atoms.a: ssml:<break time='500ms'/> she was late to the class, she completed the work on time.
atoms.b: ((++Although Whether)) she was late to the class, she completed the work on time.

atoms.a: ssml: Peter failed the test <break time='500ms'/> he studied for it.
atoms.b: Peter failed the test ((++even_though so_that)) he studied for it.

atoms.a: ssml: <break time='500ms'/> her mum had told her not to, Rebecca played in the woods.
atoms.b: ((++Although Despite)) her mum had told her not to, Rebecca played in the woods.
